# StreamDek Mobile v2.0.9

## What's New

- Added support for SkyStream (.sky) extensions. Paste a SkyStream repository link under Settings > Plugins and its sources appear in their own "SkyStream Collections" section, each one switched on individually. These were previously read as CloudStream extensions and failed to turn on at all.
- Added per-source settings for SkyStream extensions. Sources that offer their own options — Torrentio's debrid service, for example — can now be configured from the settings button next to them instead of running on defaults.
- Added support for "mega" repository links that bundle several collections together. Adding one installs everything published beneath it as a single entry, and a link carrying both SkyStream and CloudStream extensions installs the right sources into each.
- Added Deepbrid to Premium Services.
- Added support for metadata add-ons such as aiometadata. Titles they provide now open with the add-on's own details, artwork and episode lists, where before their cards opened onto an empty page.
- Added a "StreamDek Formatting" setting under Settings > Streams. Off by default, results now appear exactly as the add-on sent them, line breaks and all. Turn it on for StreamDek's own tidied three-line layout.
- Added a long-press menu to the Downloads list.
- Redesigned the Plugins page.

## Improvements

- Trailers can now play in 4K. StreamDek asks YouTube for the highest quality it publishes, which is only available in newer video formats than it previously accepted, and the trailer resolution setting now defaults to 4K. It remains a ceiling — a trailer only offered in 1080p still plays at 1080p.
- Media detail pages now load in order: the page itself first, then sources, then the trailer. Everything used to start at once and compete, which left the part you are looking at until last.
- IPTV playlist links containing filters or tokens are now accepted. Links with characters such as `|`, `[ ]` or spaces in them were rejected outright before ever being tried.
- Very large IPTV playlists now load. Lists in the 100,000–200,000 channel range previously ran the app out of memory partway through; playlists are now read as they download rather than being held whole.
- A playlist that a provider will only serve to a recognised media player is now retried automatically.
- Badges on stream results no longer reload while sources are still arriving.
- Live channel favourites and category grouping are now cached, so returning to a large channel list is immediate.
- Swiping the Home hero now moves cleanly from one image to the next, with no gap between them.
- Movie details cards now reflow to fit the screen, so the release date is no longer cut off on ordinary phone widths.
- The loading spinner on the Streams tab now sits over the label rather than beside it, so the button no longer grows and crowds the row.
- Continue Watching is now hidden with an explanation when MDBList is the primary service, as MDBList has no playback history to read.
- SIMKL watchlist and Continue Watching rows now show artwork and open correctly.

## Fixes

- Fixed a different title starting on its own during playback. Opening something from Continue Watching and then playing something else could leave the first title queued, and it would take over the player minutes later — most visibly with the streams list hidden, where playback starts within seconds of tapping Play.
- Fixed the size shown on a stream being wrong when the source listed a bitrate. A 3.3 GB result could be labelled 3.3 MB, and the same mistake let oversized results through the maximum file size limit.
- Fixed stream results showing something other than a size in the size badge, such as a list of languages, which squeezed the title into a narrow column.
- Fixed add-on stream text being truncated and reordered. Long descriptions were cut off mid-line and the add-on's own labelling was partly replaced.
- Fixed SIMKL and MDBList watchlist items showing no image.
- Fixed the Downloads and Plugins counts.
